items.angle: Discuss the difference between a doctrinal claim and observable experience, avoid formulaic warnings.
A concrete temple object or ordinary scene opens the passage; use it to explain the term through a distinct detail.
Start with a distinction that matters when reading a historical source; explain why this distinction changes interpretation.
A small dilemma in daily practice leads to a reflective argument; do not force a scientific analogy.
A casual friend-to-friend explanation beginning mid-conversation; no canned ending and no repeated two-person Q/A frame.
Help a reader understand an unfamiliar idea through one concrete example and a contrast, with no stock exam coaching.
items.factNote: Classical Yoga distinguishes purusha and prakriti; do not equate its liberation with Advaita identity of atman and brahman.

items.reading: ゔぃぱっさなーめいそう
items.angle: Explore the choice of this word in translation or an everyday explanation; avoid presentation advice and the phrase 発表で.
Trace one idea or artifact across cultures, with attribution of traditions and no invented chronology.
Compare lived practice with an oversimplified popular description, without ending in the same moral.

note: All passages remain topic india, including comparative philosophy and meditation science. Tradition and legend must be marked as such. For the target バガヴァッド・ギーター only, mentioning that text is required despite the general avoid list. Avoid these automatic last-six-character endings: る必要がある,みてください,ほかならない,すくなります,かもしれない,見えてきます,ているのです. End with a specific detail or concrete consequence.
